claims.claim: The official metric implementation reproduces the published worked example TP_w=3.00, FP_w=1.89, FN_w=2.00, DTI=0.60, and its optimized calculation agrees with a brute-force reference on the test cases.
The binary-mass identity used in local DTI analysis is DTI=T/(T+0.2F+0.8(K-T))=T/(0.2(T+F)+0.8K), with T=TP_w, F=FP_w and K=|G|; this follows from FN_w=K-T for binary predictions.

The competition template grid is EPSG:32611, 100 m, 3730 x 3292; sample_submission.tif defines the output grid and finite footprint in this checkout. claims.claim: On the off-catalogue A/B instrument (independently split fault systems; matched mass M/|G|=3.47; four folds), multiplying the static H-D fold field by a Gaussian weight in the distance-to-visible-inventory coordinate with centre 15 px and sigma 15 px raises mean DTI_all from 0.188507 (unweighted) to 0.205821 (+0.017314) and mean DTI_far from 0.081198 to 0.083816, while the near-field profile (centre 3 px, sigma 3 px) falls to 0.174227 / 0.028322. The weight is applied at emission time from the visible catalogue only and adds no model feature, so it does not reintroduce catalogue leakage into the detector. This is a proxy measurement on the visible catalogue, not an organizer score.

The static (58 physical-layer) field, fitted on split-A systems only and scored against independently held-out split-B fault pixels that lie at least 5 px from every A pixel, reaches AUC_all 0.6302 / 0.7789 / 0.6572 / 0.7080 (mean 0.6936) and AUC_far 0.5658 / 0.7477 / 0.6140 / 0.6669 (mean 0.6486) over folds 0-3. The physical arm therefore ranks unmapped, non-adjacent fault pixels above chance without any catalogue-distance feature; the inventory-context arm (H51-N1) loses to it in every regime on the same folds.
claims.source: local measurements on owner-mirrored hash-pinned competition data

claims.claim: Because alpha + beta = 1 in the published metric, a submission of M unit-valued dots with mean triangular-kernel credit k scores DTI = k*M/(0.2*M + 0.8*|G|); the index is strictly increasing in a common dot value v, so v = 1 is optimal for a fixed support; and appending one further unit dot improves the score iff its marginal credit exceeds 0.2*DTI (about 0.056 at DTI = 0.28). No hidden-label quantity is assumed.

Treating the owner-reported 0.2600 and 0.2778 for the 44,090 px dotted support and its 37,654 px catalogue-halo-deleted derivative (both supports MEASURED here) as accurate, and assuming the surviving dots keep their credit, eliminating the common credit term gives R = 200.6 - 0.01424*|G| for the total credit R of the 6,436 deleted dots. R >= 0 therefore requires |G| <= 14,088 truth pixels, and at the repository's 12,700-pixel planning value the deleted dots averaged 0.003 credit each. This is arithmetic on owner-reported numbers, not an organizer-authenticated measurement, and it establishes no hidden-label property by itself.
claims.source: owner-reported scores (not organizer-verified); official metric definition

The official INGENIOUS GDR v2 field definitions specify SLIPRT2023 in mm/year and SLIPRTNUM as its numeric portion. An audit matched all 1,126 locally mirrored trace records to the source DBF by name, numeric rate and slip sense. A separate geometry audit used 84,331 projected source trace segments clipped to 10 km tiles and the moment-tensor summation eps_dot_ij = 1/2 sum_k [L_k*u_dot_k/(A*sin(delta_k))] (n_i*m_j+n_j*m_i), sourced to Kreemer et al. (2000), Eq. 3. The source does not resolve whether every slip rate is vertical or fault-plane component, individual dips remain unknown, and official geodetic metadata preserves both 1e-9 and 1e-8 scale scenarios. Therefore the vector-budget residual is a separate coarse diagnostic, not an exact absolute strain inversion or a fine-scale locator; the legacy rank-space Stage-1 prior is not silently changed.

The K2-08 Stage-1 prior uses projected INGENIOUS/QFault source trace tensors and Kreemer et al. (2000), Eq. 3; it subtracts fault-tensor dilation from the supplied dilation scalar and fault-tensor scalar shear from the supplied shear scalar under both 1e-9/1e-8 per-year geodetic scales and vertical/fault-plane slip-component scenarios, then ranks residuals as a 20 km tile prior. Five scattered whole-trace splits approved 90.3288% mean area, recalled 90.9983% of held trace pixels (lift 1.00747), Spearman 0.14227, and uniform approved-area DTI 0.0633556 vs 0.0636448 over support (paired delta -0.0002892). This is weak broad-prior evidence, not a spatially independent validation or fine-scale locator; it is not the legacy rank-space second-invariant diagnostic.

K2-08 uses a fresh 0.5 H-D + 0.5 H-H+K2 blend and is compared with a fresh 0.5 H-D + 0.5 H-H baseline. The six-fold visible-catalogue mean is 0.2845355 ungated and 0.2748879 under the preregistered physical q10 gate; the fresh gated baseline is 0.2755433 (paired delta -0.0006554, 2/6 folds positive). The frozen historical mean is 0.2853406; the fresh ungated reconstruction is 0.2853152, outside the 1e-5 reproduction tolerance.
